Definition: to have affection f or (sexually or otherwise)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to love; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) human love for another, includes family, and sexual; 1a2) human appetite for objects such as food, drink, sleep, wisdom; 1a3) human love for or to God; 1a4) act of being a friend; 1a4a) lover (participle); 1a4b) friend (participle); 1a5) God's love toward man; 1a5a) to individual men; 1a5b) to people Israel; 1a5c) to righteousness; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) lovely (participle); 1b2) loveable (participle); 1c) (Piel); 1c1) friends; 1c2) lovers (fig. of adulterers); 2) to like
